s.how: Sear a 300g eye fillet to rare, rest and slice thin. Toast baguette slices and top with the beef and horseradish cream. Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche, 100g smoked salmon and chives. Serve on black trays.

s.note: Batman's trip to Hong Kong to grab Lau
s.how: Cut 800g pork belly into cubes and toss with 3 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp five spice. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, glazing twice. Quick-pickle a sliced cucumber in rice vinegar. Serve on toothpicks.

m.note: Bruce makes the restaurant push two tables together
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and 1 tbsp capers and spoon over. Serve with a peppery rocket salad.

w.note: Harvey's coin, one side clean, one side scarred
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a tart tin. Pour in 250g dark chocolate melted with 250ml cream and set 4 hours. Dust one half with icing sugar and the other with cocoa. Cut down the middle.

d.how: Pour 30ml single malt Scotch neat into each of four tumblers. Put a jug of water on the side. Some men just want to watch the world burn, the rest want a quiet drink.
